sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct case after each preposition
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный падеж после каждого предлога

items.prompt: Мы едем в _____. (We're going to the city.) - direction
items.hint: В + accusative for direction. Город is inanimate masculine.
items.explanation: В + accusative for direction: город stays город (inanimate masculine, no change).

items.prompt: Мы живём в _____. (We live in the city.) - location
items.explanation: В + prepositional for location: город → городе.

items.prompt: Она пришла без _____. (She came without an umbrella.)
Он идёт к _____. (He's going to his friend.)

minimalPairs.context: Я иду на _____. (I'm going TO the concert.) - direction
minimalPairs.explanation: На + accusative for direction. Концерт is inanimate masculine, no change.

minimalPairs.context: Я сижу на _____. (I'm sitting AT the concert.) - location
minimalPairs.explanation: На + prepositional for location: концерт → концерте.

minimalPairs.context: Кошка сидит под _____. (The cat sits under the table.) - location
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The cat sits under the table.
minimalPairs.explanation: Под + instrumental for location: стол → столом.

minimalPairs.context: Она положила книгу на _____. (She put the book on the table.) - direction
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She put the book on the table.
minimalPairs.explanation: На + accusative for direction (placing onto): стол stays стол (inanimate).

blanks: Я пришёл из _____. (I came from the library.)
Это подарок для _____. (This is a gift for my sister.)
Он работает с _____. (He works with his brother.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Из + genitive, для + genitive, с + instrumental
hints: Из (from) takes genitive. Библиотека is feminine -а.
Для (for) takes genitive. Сестра is feminine -а.
С (with) takes instrumental. Брат is masculine.

sets.title: Sort and Correct
sets.description: Sort prepositions by case and fix preposition-case errors
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте предлоги по падежам и исправьте ошибки

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these prepositions by the case they require

errorCorrection.hint: Living somewhere is location, not direction.
errorCorrection.explanation: Жить (live) = location. В + prepositional: Москва → Москве (not accusative Москву).
К + dative: друг → другу (not друга, which is genitive).
По + dative: парк → парку (not парка, which is genitive).
Под + instrumental: стол → столом (not столе, which is prepositional).

sets.title: Direction or Location?
sets.description: Master the в/на accusative (direction) vs prepositional (location) distinction

items.prompt: Дети бегут на _____. (The children are running to the playground.)
items.promptEnglish: The children are running to the playground. (direction)
items.explanation: На + accusative for direction: площадка → площадку.

items.prompt: Дети играют на _____. (The children are playing at the playground.)
items.promptEnglish: The children are playing at the playground. (location)
items.explanation: На + prepositional for location: площадка → площадке.

items.prompt: Мы ходим в _____. (We go to the gym regularly.)
items.hint: Going TO = direction = в + accusative. Masculine inanimate.
items.explanation: В + accusative for direction: спортзал stays спортзал (inanimate masc.).

items.prompt: Он занимается в _____. (He exercises at the gym.)
items.explanation: В + prepositional for location: спортзал → спортзале.

minimalPairs.context: Я еду в _____. (I'm traveling to Russia.) - direction
minimalPairs.explanation: В + accusative for direction: Россия → Россию.

minimalPairs.context: Я живу в _____. (I live in Russia.) - location
minimalPairs.explanation: В + prepositional for location: Россия → России.

minimalPairs.context: Мы пошли на _____. (We went to work.) - direction
minimalPairs.explanation: На + accusative for direction: работа → работу.

minimalPairs.context: Мы сидим на _____. (We're sitting at work.) - location
minimalPairs.explanation: На + prepositional for location: работа → работе.

sets.title: Spot the Pattern
sets.description: Recognize which case each preposition demands
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите, какой падеж требует каждый предлог

patternRecognition.sentence: в школу, на работу, через дорогу, за угол
patternRecognition.question: What case do all these prepositions require in these examples?
patternRecognition.explanation: All examples show motion/direction: в/на + accusative, через + accusative, за + accusative.

patternRecognition.sentence: из школы, от друга, без денег, для мамы, до вечера
patternRecognition.question: What case do all these prepositions require?
patternRecognition.explanation: Из, от, без, для, до all require genitive case.

patternRecognition.sentence: в школе → из школы, на работе → с работы
patternRecognition.question: What pattern connects location prepositions to their 'from' counterparts?
options: В pairs with из; на pairs with с
В pairs with с; на pairs with из
patternRecognition.answer: В pairs with из; на pairs with с
patternRecognition.explanation: В (in) pairs with из (out of). На (on) pairs with с (off of). Location → source.

blanks: Мы идём через _____. (We're walking through the park.)
Лампа висит над _____. (The lamp hangs above the table.)
Он гуляет по _____. (He walks along the street.)
Я вернусь до _____. (I'll be back by evening.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: через + acc, над + inst, по + dat, до + gen
hints: Через (through) takes accusative. Парк is inanimate masculine.
Над (above) takes instrumental. Стол is masculine.
По (along) takes dative. Улица is feminine.
До (until) takes genitive. Вечер is masculine.
explanations: Через + accusative: парк stays парк (inanimate masculine).

minimalPairs.context: Он сидит за _____. (He sits behind the desk.) - location
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He sits behind the desk. (location = instrumental)
minimalPairs.explanation: За + instrumental for location (behind): стол → столом.

minimalPairs.context: Он сел за _____. (He sat down at the desk.) - direction/motion
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He sat down at the desk. (direction = accusative)
minimalPairs.explanation: За + accusative for direction (moving to sit): стол stays стол (inanimate).

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A final round mixing all preposition-case combinations
sets.descriptionRussian: Финальный раунд: все сочетания предлогов с падежами

items.prompt: Она мечтает о _____. (She dreams about a vacation.)
Мы пришли с _____. (We came from the concert.)
items.hint: С (from) takes genitive. This is different from с (with) + instrumental.

items.prompt: Птица летит над _____. (The bird flies above the forest.)
items.promptEnglish: The bird flies above the forest.

items.prompt: Дети играют около _____. (The children play near the house.)
items.promptEnglish: The children play near the house.

errorCorrection.hint: Из takes genitive, not accusative. Also, 'from work' uses с, not из.
errorCorrection.explanation: Из takes genitive: работа → работы. Note: 'from work' is actually с работы (с + genitive), since на работе pairs with с работы.

errorCorrection.hint: Sitting IN is location, not direction.
errorCorrection.explanation: Location = в + prepositional: стул → стуле (not accusative стул).

errorCorrection.sentence: Она идёт с другом в магазине.
errorCorrection.explanation: Идёт (going) = direction. В + accusative: магазин stays магазин (not prepositional магазине).
